arguments.content: Delayed cleanup must remain scoped to the operation that scheduled it, even in a serialized store. A mutable parent key (such as workspace_id) can point to a replacement operation by the time queued cleanup or a retry runs; deleting solely by that key removes a successful replacement. Preserve an operation identity/ownership check before deleting active state, while independently removing the failed operation's pending record. Verification should cover failed operation pending -> replacement completes -> stale cleanup -> unchanged consumer still sees replacement, plus stale retry after later reuse and same-owner cleanup controls. These lifecycle checks expose regressions that same-owner cleanup tests miss without requiring concurrency. Confirmed P1 in staged cleanup.py versus HEAD a7ab15e9fc17243d0f00288ca01907dd06dcdb73.
